source: GitHub (zwh8800/recalbox-saves, a personal backup of Recalbox and handheld RetroArch save folders)
author: zwh8800 (commits signed wastecat / zzz)
what_it_is: Metal Slug X MVS backup RAM written by libretro MAME 2003 on a Recalbox (Recalbox's neogeo system folder); game state unknown
attribution: from the repo path only: 'saves/neogeo/mame2003/nvram/mslugx.nv'. The 'mame2003' folder is the save subdirectory that core creates; nothing else on the page names the core or the game state
note: 8192 bytes: MAME 2003 saves only the first 8 KiB of the 64 KiB MVS backup RAM, in the 68000's byte order (BACKUP RAM OK ! reads straight)
